reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: They put you through a whole intake process and then expect you to join without ever telling you how much it will cost. Fat chance. Cancel anytime means they will not make canceling easy. Be honest and state all costs upfront before we commit.

reviews.title: Bad Reviews / App too Intrusive / High Prices
reviews.text:
App is too intrusive in getting access to contacts, search history, purchases, and so on. I don’t like apps that farm all your data! 
Also too many bad reviews. Prices are too high. 
To much AI generated media.
Not for me.

reviews.title: Basic Features Malfunction
reviews.text: For such a pricey app I would expect for basic functionality to be a lot better. The audio doesn’t play automatically as you can tell it’s meant to, and even when a video is selected , you often still need to tap the mute button on and off again to get the sound to start playing. Then, after about 15 seconds, the sound cuts off again. Smh. I wouldn’t try taking a master class in 15 second malfunction bursts butane that’s just me .

reviews.title: Not Paying!
reviews.text: I am not paying a dime for an app. Access should be free. Delete! Don’t waste your time or money.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Nice idea but not worth paying for. I canceled through settings in the app and I better not get charged. Seeing reviews about people getting charged after canceling in the free trial makes me suspicious. I hate apps that are set up like this.

reviews.title: After full access, still need to pay more for recipes
reviews.text: After pay for full access, that wants you to pay more to see other recipes.

reviews.title: Predatory
reviews.text:
Gives you no free content whatsoever and forces you to subscribe before finishing sign up, also not sure if it was just me but the only option they gave me was for the 100$ year purchase
As a professional in the industry, stick to YouTube

reviews.title: Doesn’t tell you cost before you sign up
reviews.text: I never got to use the app so I can’t comment on the content, but I’m annoyed that it forces you to sign up for free and of course signs you up to a potential subscription without giving you the cost up front. Felt like a con so I backed out and deleted the app. It’s a shame that you can’t try it without doing this step.

reviews.title: Its s subscription
reviews.text: Very frustrating they don’t tell you that before you get the app

reviews.title: Cool ideas, bad user experience
reviews.text: I want to like the app, and as a career chef, I love browsing interesting ideas and techniques. However, the app experience really gets on my nerves. First of all, you can’t avoid the videos autoplaying. I hate autoplay video. It’s takes over whatever you were listening to when you launch the app. Secondly, there’s no way to print or export the recipes in any way. When I want to try a recipe from Gronda, I usually end up writing the recipe by hand. I prefer to import recipes into other apps where I can take notes and refer to them later. Another nitpick is that it’s not very good at searching recipes by ingredient, or technique. It would also be nice to search recipes by equipment, such as thermomix or pacojet. Hopefully the experience improves before my next renewal comes due.

reviews.title: Money app
reviews.text: Deceitful app that wants you to create an account, give them personal information, then and only then tells you it’s free for now.  Payment later.

reviews.title: 7-day free trial is a scam!!!
reviews.text: I paid for the 7 day free trial and after 48 hours decided the recipes were NOT practical and therefore not for me so I cancelled my subscription but Gronda refused to refund my money. So warning they do not honor their 7 day free trial!!

reviews.title: Overpriced
reviews.text: Overpriced app and will charge you the full price without reminders that the trial period is over and renewal is coming up.

reviews.title: Scam?
reviews.text: Please explain to me why my only option to start the app is the 1 week free trial with 99.99/yr subscription, but your annual subscription cost is only 53$ for Gronda Pro? Good app otherwise outside of poor pricing practice and lack of organization within the app

reviews.title: Could be the least responsive app ever
reviews.text: My son gave me an upgrade toPRO for Christmas. I had downloaded the app over a year ago but never used it because every recipe seemed to be beyond a pay wall. To use the gift certificate i need my pw, which I forgot. The reset says they will send you an email. I’ve tried ten times on four diff devices and yet to get an email. Tried contacting on insta and recd no response. Got an email asking to set up a time to talk about the App. Never received a call. This seems like a grift.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
My minor child accidentally purchased a subscription while using my phone, without my authorization. I immediately canceled and contacted support, but the refund was denied despite this being a clear case of an unauthorized purchase by a child.

For an app that allows subscriptions to be purchased so easily, there should be better safeguards or more reasonable handling of situations involving minors. Parents shouldn’t be penalized for accidental purchases made by children.

Very disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Good content, if you can access it.
reviews.text: I subscribed to pro, created my account, was exiting to create my recipes library but after after a couple weeks I was logged out of the app and never was able to login because they just can’t find my account; customer support is useless they never provide a solution.  I just “donate” $99.99 to the developer.
